blocks.text: The Programme has compiled a short list of presents that are suitable for family members. None of them are sold in a pro shop.

text: • Flowers, from a shop, not the clubhouse raffle.
• A meal out at a restaurant that is not in a golf club.
• A weekend away somewhere without a course. The Programme accepts that this will take some research.
• Tickets for something your wife wants to see, which you will also attend.
• Your time, given willingly, on a Saturday.
